title: Can I sign up using my York email address or personal email address
issue: Can I sign up using my York email address or personal email address
resolution_html: You can sign up for 1Password using either your York email address or a personal email address. The choice depends on your preference and intended use. Using your York email might be beneficial if you are using 1Password for work-related purposes, as it can simplify account management and access within an organizational context
